items.reason: Tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides helps keep the look of dark patches from deepening and evens out the look of tone.
A gentle ceramide moisturizer comforts the look of dry, low-moisture skin without adding anything that could irritate.

response.routine_note: A mole that has grown and darkened this year should be checked by a dermatologist soon, so please book that before adding any brightening products, which is why none are included here. Meanwhile, apply the moisturizer morning and night and the tinted SPF every morning, reapplying if you are outdoors.
